card.name: End of a heading before body text
card.fires_on: The last word or mark of a short title or section heading, just before the body text starts on the same line. Seen in scraped web pages where headings run straight into paragraphs.

modes.label: Heading last word
modes.description: Final word of a section title that is followed by running text.

modes.label: Heading punctuation
modes.description: A comma, period or quote closing a title or list item before the next block.

modes.label: Heading middle word
modes.description: A word inside a heading such as Before the Procedure.

card.writes: It suppresses closing-quote and paragraph-break tokens, so it seems to push the model toward starting new text after a heading.
card.plain: It marks the end of a heading that runs straight into the text below it on scraped web pages.
